# File-format fixtures

Handcrafted test data for `lib/gpx-tcx`, `lib/geojson` and `lib/fit`. Every file here was written
by hand or generated by code in this repository; none is a real recording or a copy of a vendor
file. The "device style" names describe the dialect being imitated only.

| Path | What it exercises |
|---|---|
| `gpx/garmin-edge-tpx-v1.gpx` | TrackPointExtension v1 under an `ns3` prefix, `<power>`, two segments, a waypoint |
| `gpx/watch-tpx-v2-powerext.gpx` | TrackPointExtension v2 `speed`, PowerExtension `PowerInWatts`, `+10:00` offset, fractional seconds |
| `gpx/cluetrust-gpxdata.gpx` | Cluetrust `gpxdata:hr/cadence/temp/distance` |
| `gpx/phone-app-generic-ext.gpx` | un-namespaced `heartrate`/`cadence`/`power`, zone-less timestamp, no namespace at all |
| `gpx/gpx10-route-no-times.gpx` | GPX 1.0 namespace, `<rte>`, time-less track, core `<speed>` |
| `gpx/messy-values-bom.gpx` | UTF-8 BOM + whitespace before `<?xml`, bad numbers/times, out-of-range and missing latitude |
| `gpx/malformed-truncated.gpx` | file cut off mid-point (recorder crash) |
| `gpx/malformed-xxe.gpx` | DOCTYPE with an external entity (must be rejected) |
| `gpx/not-gpx.xml` | wrong root element |
| `tcx/forerunner-run-2laps.tcx` | leading whitespace, 2 laps, `TPX` Speed/RunCadence/Watts, `LX` lap extensions, Creator |
| `tcx/indoor-bike-no-gps.tcx` | no positions, default-namespace `TPX`, lap without StartTime/totals |
| `geojson/*.geojson` | every geometry type, foreign members, `crs`, 4-value positions, malformed inputs |
| `fit/handcrafted-mixed.fit` | built by `fit/make_handcrafted_fit.py`: big-endian definitions, developer fields, compressed timestamps with roll-over, odd field sizes, unknown message |
| `golden/*` | expected writer output; regenerate with `UPDATE_GOLDENS=true ./gradlew :lib:<name>:test` and review the diff |
| `crossval/crossvalidate.py` | re-reads the FIT and GPX goldens with `fitdecode` and `gpxpy` |
